extDesc.message: Translates web pages with AI that understands context: it leaves code, commands, identifiers and proper names untouched.

menuToggle.message: Translate page with AI / show original

svcChromeDesc.message: The translator built into Chrome. No account needed: what you read never leaves your computer.

svcHybridDesc.message: Chrome Translator translates on your computer. Only sentences that come out with broken links or bold text go to Gemini, to fix them.

svcNoTranslator.message: Not available in this browser. Chrome Translator comes with Google Chrome.

svcGeminiDesc.message: Google's AI reads the page before translating it: it understands the topic and keeps proper names better. All the text goes to Google.

svcAnthropicDesc.message: Paid. Requires an Anthropic API key.

svcOpenaiDesc.message: Paid. Requires an OpenAI API key.

svcOpenrouterDesc.message: Hundreds of models with a single key; some are free.

svcLmstudioDesc.message: A model running on your computer with LM Studio.

svcOllamaDesc.message: A model running on your computer with Ollama.

svcCustomDesc.message: Enter the server address and, if it asks for one, its API key.

chromeInfoNoNanoHw.message: Gemini Nano doesn't run on this computer (it needs more than 4 GB of graphics memory or 16 GB of RAM, and 22 GB of free disk space), so a sentence with broken links or bold text stays in the original language. To have an AI fix it, choose “$1”. It also happens when the graphics card is busy (another AI model, a game, video editing…): free it up and restart Chrome.

guideTitle.message: Get your free API key in a minute

guide1.message: Open Google AI Studio and sign in with your Google account.

guide2.message: Accept the terms if asked. If you don't see a key, click $1.

guide4.message: Copy the key and paste it below. We'll pick the best model for translating.

guideNote.message: No credit card needed. If you hit the per-minute limit, translation waits a few seconds and continues on its own. Google may use what you send with a free key to improve its products.

serverLmstudio.message: In LM Studio: Developer → Local Server, start the server.

ollamaAllow.message: Allow this extension. Until you do, Ollama rejects it with error 403.

ollamaContext.message: With less than 24 GB of graphics memory, Ollama reads only 4096 tokens per request and silently drops the rest. That's why 1500 characters are sent at a time (Advanced → Speed). To send more, add $1 under the permission and restart Ollama: it uses more graphics memory.

localSlow.message: Models on your computer can translate more slowly than online services: it depends on your graphics card. For translating we recommend Gemma 4 12B, which needs about 8 GB of graphics memory.

keyNote.message: Stored only in this browser and sent only to this service.

modelsLoading.message: Looking up the models on your account…

modelsNone.message: The service returned no text models: type the name yourself.

modelsTryPart.message: Try a shorter part of the name.

modelsNoFilterMatch.message: No model matches the filters you chose.

modelsOkPicked.message: ✓ $1. Models available: $2. We picked $3, the recommended one for translating.

testMarks.message: It translates, but $1 broke the markers.

marksLost.message: The 🛒 icon or the link got lost. Sentences where that happens will stay in the original so the page doesn't break.

otherLangPh.message: Type the language, for example: Català…

langHint.message: If it's not on the list, choose “Other language” and type it.

langAi.message: The AI will translate into “$1”. Click Test translation to see it.

langUnknown.message: I don't recognize “$1”. Write it in English or in its own language, for example “Polish”.

localNeedLang.message: $1 needs a language it recognizes: check “Translate into”.

dlChrome.message: The language needs to be downloaded (a few MB, only once).

showBadge.message: Show the indicator on the page

showBadgeHint.message: A small notice at the bottom right with the progress and a button to see the original.

useCacheHint.message: When you come back to a page, it's translated instantly and doesn't use up your limit.

contextHint.message: The AI first reads what the page is about so it can respect names and terms. It makes one extra request per page.

uiEnglishHint.message: Shows the extension in English even if your browser uses another language. Its name and keyboard shortcut still follow the browser.

sitesHint.message: One site per line, for example $1. Includes its subdomains.

advancedSummary.message: Style instructions, glossary, parts to exclude, speed and saved translations.

stylePh.message: E.g.: Casual tone. Keep product and TV show names in their original language.

styleHint.message: Optional. Not used with Chrome Translator, which doesn't take instructions.

glossaryHint.message: One rule per line. "X = Y" always translates X as Y; just "X" keeps it untranslated. Whole words, upper or lower case. With Chrome Translator, Y goes in exactly as written, so the words around it may not agree with it.

skipLabel.message: Parts of the page you don't want translated

skipHint.message: Only if a site translates something you want to keep as it is (prices, names, usernames). Use CSS selectors, one per line; with $1 in front, it applies only to that site. Brands, @usernames, #hashtags, addresses, emails, code and commands are already kept automatically.

speedHint.message: These adjust themselves when you choose a service. With LM Studio or Ollama, 1 request at a time and about 1500 characters works best.

clearHint.message: Useful if you changed services and want pages to be translated again.

sessionKeys.message: Forget API keys when closing the browser

sessionKeysHint.message: They aren't saved on this computer: you'll paste them again each time you open the browser. Useful on a shared computer.

keyLimitGemini.message: If you don't turn on billing in Google AI Studio, this key can't generate charges, even if someone else gets it.

keyLimitOpenrouter.message: Set a credit limit on this key in OpenRouter: if someone else gets it, they can't spend more than that.

keyLimitOpenai.message: Set a monthly budget and turn off auto recharge in your OpenAI billing: if someone else gets the key, the damage has a cap.

keyLimitAnthropic.message: Set a spend limit and turn off auto reload in your Anthropic billing: if someone else gets the key, the damage has a cap.

selReplaceStale.message: The text in the field changed: select it again.

selTooLong.message: Too much text: select up to $1 characters, or translate the whole page.

selRateLimit.message: API limit: try again in $1 s.

selectionButton.message: Show a button when you select text

selectionButtonHint.message: Click it to see the translation of what you selected. You can also use “Translate selection” in the right-click menu.

recentEmpty.message: Translations of text you select show up here (the last 20).

keepRecentHint.message: The last 20 translations of selected text, to see them again in the toolbar popup. Only on this computer; turning it off deletes them.
